# Grandpa Ape Country Club (GACC)

> The Grandpa Ape Country Club is a collection of 5,000 unique Grandpa Ape NFTs on the Ethereum blockchain. Your NFT doubles as your membership to the country club.

## Collections

### GACC (Grandpa Ape Country Club)
- 5,000 unique Grandpa Ape NFTs on Ethereum
- Contract: 0x495f947276749Ce646f68AC8c248420045cb7b5e (OpenSea Shared Storefront)
- OpenSea: https://opensea.io/collection/grandpa-ape-country-club
- Features: Rank lookup, subdomain manager, member dashboard

### MACC (Mutant Ape Country Club)
- Up to 10,000 Mutant Ape NFTs created by exposing Grandpa Apes to mutant serum
- Derivative collection of GACC

### GAKC (Grandpa Ape Kitten Club)
- Companion kitten collection
- Kittens can be bred and earn Lunagem tokens

## Tokens

### GrandpaCoin ($GRANDPA)
- ERC-20 governance and utility token for the GACC ecosystem
- Chain: Ethereum mainnet
- Use: Ecosystem utility, community rewards
